observations.evidence: Saved CRM action was cancelled before dispatch because the harness wrapper omitted its required bindingId; its awaited callback was unreachable. Verified saved state, stopped only the identified local proof processes and removed their isolated schema/directory.
observations.correction: Wrapper now delegates the underlying bindingId and rejects a returned execution result or a 15-second post-effect wait timeout. Fresh dispatch proof passed all six checks.

observations.evidence: ENOSPC while copying standalone output; compilation completed. Removed only generated LoopLabs caches; scoped tracing to the checkout.
observations.correction: Scoped Next tracing to this checkout, removed generated caches, and reran the cache-disabled standalone build successfully. The real-browser proof then passed all 12 checks against fresh bundles.

observations.evidence: Worker restore wait timed out; Docker container metadata writes and blob reads returned input/output errors. Host filesystem had 123 MiB available during the simultaneous build. Prior checks reached exactly two approved effects.
observations.correction: Freed generated cache space, removed only unused build cache older than 24 hours, and restarted Docker through its official CLI without resetting it. Cleaned only the failed isolated proof containers/network/volume. A fresh unchanged container drill passed all 17 checks with exactly two effects.

scope: Sanitized validation history, not a production reliability claim.
